decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-a5a74f4cd759] names the subject: Envoy logs emitted on connection failures. It states the change: those logs now show more error details. It also states the scope that the open applicability aspect needs: the change is limited to ambient mode, so applicability can be written as "environment runs Istio in ambient mode". The note describes only richer log output and no required action or functional change, so an informational or no-impact consequence can be written. It does not say which log fields or which Envoy-based components are affected, but that does not change the applicability or the consequence class.
